description: Relationship edges for one entity (pass entity_id) or the whole campaign (omit it). Focused mode (entity_id passed) emits one row per other entity as other_id/other_name/other_type. Whole-campaign mode (entity_id omitted) emits one row per entity pair, naming both endpoints as from_id/from_name/from_type and to_id/to_name/to_type. Each edge has a source: SESSION (seen together in sessions; weight counts shared moments) or RECORD (a link between the saved records linked to the two entities; last_session is null; it always names both ends as from_*/to_*, so its direction is clear in focused mode too). Capped at 'limit' edges (default 25, max 100); the service caps at 200 total.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's nextCursor

entity_id.description: Optional entity UUID to focus on
